message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Node CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - sdk-automation/models
      - promote/main
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  node-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6.0.3
      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Cache Node.js modules
        uses: actions/cache@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae # v5.0.5
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
      - name: Lint code
        run: npm run lint:fix && npm run lint

  node-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    needs: node-check

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x, 22.x]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6.0.3
      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Cache Node.js modules
        uses: actions/cache@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae # v5.0.5
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: npm run test:coverage",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by measured CI workflow evidence showing about 26.8% elapsed savings and by the pattern catalogue's reported vm-time reduction for custom timeouts. The repository's historical runs are short (roughly 1.5-2 minutes each), so a 5-minute timeout gives operational headroom without triggering the 'valid slow runs exceed the limit' contraindication. Adding timeout-minutes: 5 to both jobs bounds runaway consumption while preserving every existing step (checkout, setup, cache, install, lint, typecheck-equivalent lint, and test:coverage across the node matrix) and without changing permissions, secrets, or deployment behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
